headline: Zozzoli Opens $20 Million Argentine Wood Processing Facility for Exports
summary: Family-owned firm Zozzoli opened a $20 million wood processing plant in Santo Tomé, Corrientes. The plant will process 500 tonnes of timber daily, exporting 100% of output to the US and European Union.
why: Private capital investments in South American forestry and timber manufacturing expand regional exports and local employment.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: A new $20 million export manufacturing plant generates foreign exchange revenue and regional jobs.
